name: Savoy Palace
positioning: Superior 5-star hotel on Madeira Island, inspired by the island's landscapes and traditions, with a spa modeled on Madeira's native Laurissilva forest
best_for: Travelers who want ocean-view rooms and suites on Madeira Island
Guests interested in spa time and island experiences such as wine tastings and tours

facts.text: Savoy Palace is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World and Virtuoso.
With individually created areas within the property, Savoy Palace offers the atmosphere of a boutique hotel.
The resort takes inspiration from the lush landscapes and elaborate traditions of Madeira Island.
The magical garden of Madeira Island was the inspiration for Laurea Spa.
Accommodations include Ocean Rooms, Superior Ocean Rooms, Ocean Junior Suites, Ocean Suites and Superior Ocean Suites.
The hotel offers a Two Bedroom Family Suite.
Garden Rooms look onto flowers and plants.
A Local Food Workshop lets guests take Madeira's flavours home.
Galáxia is the hotel's fine-dining restaurant.
The hotel is at Av. do Infante 25 in Madeira.
A relaxation day spa experience is offered.
Avenue Rooms open onto the city.

highlights.text: Laurea Spa was inspired by Madeira's Laurissilva, a forest type native to the island.
With individually created areas within the property, Savoy Palace offers the atmosphere of a boutique hotel.
Accommodations include Ocean Rooms, Superior Ocean Rooms, Ocean Junior Suites, Ocean Suites and Superior Ocean Suites.
Savoy Palace was named in the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2021, 2023, 2025 and 2026.
Guests can join a wine tasting of Portuguese wines and cheese.

considerations.text: Views depend on the room type: Avenue Rooms open onto the city and Garden Rooms onto the gardens, so ocean views mean booking an Ocean room or suite category.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is located in a busy Funchal tourist area.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
